pin.title: Ezimangweni, Amaoti, Inanda (map point approximate): three suspects shot dead in shootout with police, 25 Nov
pin.location_note: APPROXIMATE MAP POINT. A residence in the Ezimangweni area of Amaoti, Inanda. Amaoti is not in Nominatim; the pin is the Inanda (eThekwini) point (-29.715, 30.95). Area level, about 4 km.
